svg.title: Clearances either side of a V-score line
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. A vertical dashed V-score line separates two boards. On the right-hand board, shaded bands show copper kept 0.5 mm back from the line, ordinary components kept 1.3 mm back, and ceramic capacitors kept 5 mm back. A resistor sits 1.5 mm from the line and a ceramic capacitor 5.5 mm from it, both turned parallel to the line. On the left-hand board, a ceramic capacitor turned across the line and only 1 mm from it is marked as wrong.
